key_impacts: 3,520 houses washed away in Dakshin Bedkashi.
1,800 houses partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi.
Coastal embankment breached in six places; 20.55 km damaged.
Villages inundated twice daily by tidal water until 2013, delaying recovery.
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65-knot winds and a 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila and the storm surge killed 33 people, washed away 3,520 houses, and partially damaged 1,800 houses.
The storm surge overtopped the coastal embankment, breached it in six places, damaging 20.55 km of embankment; villages were tidally inundated until 2013.
